changes.title: Elena Rybakina bests defending champion Aryna Sabalenka to win her first U.S. Open
changes.summary: Aryna Sabalenka, the two-time defending U.S. Open champion, was dethroned Saturday, losing to Elena Rybakina in three sets.

changes.title: Elena Rybakina ends Aryna Sabalenka's bid for third straight US Open title
changes.summary: Elena Rybakina moved one step closer to completing a career Grand Slam Saturday, defeating Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 to win her first U.S. Open title.
